caption: The same 1.5 ZEC payment, worth ₹6,000 at ₹4,000 per ZEC, through the two address types. A transparent address puts sender, receiver and amount on the ledger; a shielded address puts only a valid proof and a pool change there.

spec.title: Zcash: one payment, two addresses
spec.aria: A flow from a 1.5 ZEC payment worth ₹6,000 into a transparent address, where the ledger shows sender, receiver and amount, and into a shielded address, where the ledger shows only a valid proof and a pool change.
